Urinary Organs. — [90.] If we measure the quantity of urine
passed daily before the administration of the drug, and again after we
administer it, we shall find in the latter case that the quantity is increased,
usually to the extent of a few ounces ; in some cases we shall find scarcely
any perceptible increase,'".
